title: MBR (Master Boot Record) partition table
summary: The MBR is the first 512 bytes of a disk. Contains: boot code (446 bytes), partition table (4 entries × 16 bytes = 64 bytes), and signature 0x55AA (2 bytes). Each partition entry: status (1), start CHS (3), type (1), end CHS (3), start LBA (4), size in sectors (4).

ext.summary: The MBR is the first 512 bytes of a disk. Contains: boot code (446 bytes), partition table (4 entries × 16 bytes = 64 bytes), and signature 0x55AA (2 bytes). Each partition entry: status (1), start CHS (3), type (1), end CHS (3), start LBA (4), size in sectors (4).

structure.meaning: x86 machine code executed by BIOS. Loads the active partition's boot sector.
Status (0x80=active), start CHS (3), type (1), end CHS (3), start LBA (4), size (4).

notes: MBR supports max 4 primary partitions (or 3 primary + 1 extended).
MBR uses 32-bit LBA → max 2TB disk size.
MBR is being replaced by GPT (GUID Partition Table) for modern systems.
The active partition's boot sector is loaded at 0x7C00 and executed.
